target.title: improve: reduce dashboard GitHub API reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves an operational problem where the ClawSweeper live dashboard spends extra GitHub API budget while building a status snapshot. Duplicate or per-item dashboard hydration can add latency and rate-limit pressure when the dashboard reads active workflow runs, live PR CI state, cluster repair metadata, recent closes, and automerge timing.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a per-status-snapshot GitHub REST reader that memoizes exact API paths and passes it through the dashboard hydration paths that run during one snapshot. Authenticated recent automerge timing now hydrates the small search page with one GraphQL request instead of per-PR REST detail calls, while preserving the existing REST fallback when GraphQL is unavailable.

## User Impact

Operators should see the same dashboard data with fewer redundant GitHub API requests during cache misses. That reduces rate-limit pressure and keeps dashboard status refreshes cheaper without changing the visible dashboard contract.

## Evidence

- `node --test test/dashboard-worker.test.ts` passed: 52 tests, 52 pass.
- `pnpm run build:dashboard` passed.
- `pnpm run lint:dashboard` passed.
- `pnpm run lint:scripts` passed.
- `pnpm run format:check` passed.
- `$env:PNPM_BIN='C:\Users\marti\AppData\Local\Corepack\shims\pnpm.CMD'; pnpm run check` passed: 1127 tests, 1126 pass, 1 Windows POSIX-mode skip, 0 failures; coverage and format gates passed.
- Codex review loop completed after implementation; review hardening added timestamp ordering for automerge command comments before the final full check.

Live dashboard status proof, redacted: ran the real `dashboard/worker.ts` status handler locally against live GitHub API with a wrapped `fetch` that counted GitHub paths. The token came from `gh auth token` and was not printed. This proves the authenticated recent-automerge path hydrated four live automerge items with one search and one GraphQL request, instead of the previous `2 * item_count` REST PR/comment detail shape.

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "generated_at": "2026-07-01T13:28:22.874Z",
  "automerge_item_numbers": [98396, 97851, 98347, 98352],
  "automerge_samples": 4,
  "recent_automerge_search_requests": 1,
  "recent_automerge_graphql_requests": 1,
  "rest_pull_detail_requests_for_automerge_items": 0,
  "rest_comment_detail_requests_for_automerge_items": 0,
  "previous_rest_detail_shape_for_same_items": 8,
  "duplicate_exact_rest_paths_observed": [],
  "graphql_operation_counts": {
    "WorkerTargetTitles": 2,
    "RecentAutomerge": 1
  },
  "github_call_count": 72
}
```
